title: SecurityFinding
description: BibleFi smart contract security finding record. Captures audit results, vulnerability reports, and on-chain attestations for BibleFi protocol contracts.

finding_id.description: Unique identifier for this security finding.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the security_finding schema used.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the security finding.

severity.description: Severity classification of the finding following standard audit conventions.

status.description: Current remediation status of the finding.

contract_address.description: EVM address of the affected smart contract.

chain_id.description: EIP-155 chain ID where the affected contract is deployed.

audit_firm.description: Name of the auditing firm or individual researcher who discovered this finding.

auditor_address.description: EVM address of the auditor or audit firm.

description.description: Detailed technical description of the vulnerability.

affected_functions.description: List of smart contract function signatures affected by this finding.

exploit_poc.description: Proof-of-concept exploit code or description demonstrating the vulnerability.

remediation_commit.description: Git commit hash or reference where the fix was implemented.

discovered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the finding was first discovered.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the finding was marked resolved.

on_chain_attestation.description: EVM transaction hash of the on-chain attestation confirming resolution.
